verdict.rationale: Otter's docs say next steps are "automatically captured and assigned from every meeting" and that summaries include action items, some with deadlines. Its own integrations send those action items into trackers such as JIRA, Asana and ClickUp, and prior action items resurface in pre-meeting briefings. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how owners are identified and attributed to speakers, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy, clarity on which plan tiers include the JIRA/Asana action-item sync (it appears on the enterprise page).
